Realtime block 1 (4S). Both temperature registers read 0x00FF, decoded here as not available (null); aiobmsble reports 215 C for them. Voltage, current, SOC and cells match aiobmsble.

Realtime block 2. Register 0x0070 = 0x0002 (SOC low alarm level 2 when decoded per patagonaa) and 0x0072 = 0x8000 (temperature detection error), consistent with the 0x00FF temperatures in block 1. aiobmsble states 20.1 Ah remaining, 0 cycles, both MOSFETs on, heater off, balancer 0.

Version block 0x0178..0x01C1 made of 14-byte fields. aiobmsble joins the first two fields as sw_version. aiobmsble states sw_version, hw_version and serial_number as given in the aiobmsble fields; the per-field split is this document.

Realtime block 1 of an ESS-DL-BMS (16S, discharging at 8.9 A). Register 0x003B changes between polls (0x00B6 here, 0x00F2 one poll later). The syssi tests state 53.0 V, -8.9 A, SOC 86.4 %, 16 cells, 4 sensors at 22 C and the cell voltages.

Realtime block 2 of the same pack: power 471 W at 0x0058 (53.0 V x 8.9 A), MOSFET 24 C, board 30 C, date and time at 0x0061..0x0063. The syssi tests state discharging, 271.2 Ah, 7 cycles, MOSFET 24 C, board 30 C, highest probe 4, lowest probe 1.
Registers 0x00A4..0x00AD. 0x00A6 = 0x00A7 = 1500 (150.0 A allowed charge and discharge current when read per Sundaya); the other words are unverified.
Version block made of 14-byte fields; syssi reads the first 28 bytes as one software version string. The syssi tests state the two syssi strings; the per-field split is this document.
